parsed.rationale: Both participating records have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/PlayerControllerBehaviorTests.swift`. Although the pipeline reports a Jaccard similarity of 0.78, the two methods carry semantically distinct names — `multipleStopCallsAreIdempotent` (verifying idempotency of repeated stop calls) and `playAfterStopWorks` (verifying playback resumes after a stop) — suggesting the structural similarity is incidental to shared test scaffolding rather than true duplication. Collapsing or extracting these test methods would obscure their individual behavioral intent and violate the principle that each test should clearly document one behaviour.
